A letter for today

no big occasion needed, but this one's a big one. Kind of like a milestone is'nt it.

My Lovely Kuchuu, My Dumdum, happy birthday. It's your Twentieth Birthday, Wow i just cant believe it no matter how many times i say it 😂 you are such a cute baby you know.

You've spent this whole year being the most caring, most patient, most quietly strong person I know and somehow you still find room to take care of everyone around you, including me, especially me, even on the days I don't make it easy. I notice it. I don't say it enough, but I notice everything.

Watching you grow this past year, I mean you really have grown alot and i am proud of you for that, the way you handle hard days without letting them turn you bitter has honestly been one of my favorite things to witness. You're becoming exactly the kind of person I always knew you were since the day we met and it makes me really happy to see it. That's not lost on me.

I want this year to hand you everything you're reaching for. Every goal you're quietly working toward, every dream you don't always say out loud. I hope this is the year they start becoming real. And whatever happens, I want to be right there next to you for it, supporting you, believing in you on the days you forget to believe in yourself.

Twenty looks good on you already. So does forever, if you ask me lol.

I love you. Happy birthday, my dream girl.

— Ashutosh
